name: habittap-promo
description: Programmatic promo video for HabitTap, built with Remotion.

scripts.audio: npm run vo && npm run music
scripts.render: remotion render PromoVertical out/habittap-promo-vertical.mp4 && python3 audio/master.py out/habittap-promo-vertical.mp4
scripts.render:landscape: remotion render PromoLandscape out/habittap-promo-landscape.mp4 && python3 audio/master.py out/habittap-promo-landscape.mp4
scripts.render:all: npm run render && npm run render:landscape
